PE and stage_groups multiply physical replication. Estimates are uncertain and must not prune candidates. Return only a JSON object with an ordered list of candidate IDs in "order". Never invent configurations or report predicted metrics as measurements. Return exactly 1 distinct candidate IDs, best first. Do not list other candidates.
